description: Module 5: Template Library - A /templates route for managing reusable message/document templates (emails, WhatsApp messages, letters). Includes template cards with categories, preview, and a detail/edit view.
steps: Create src/types/template.ts with a Template interface: id, name, category (Email|WhatsApp|Letter|SMS|Document), subject (for emails), body (template content with {{placeholders}}), tags (string array), status (Active|Draft|Archived), lastModified, usageCount

Create src/lib/mock-templates.ts with 8-10 mock templates covering the categories: welcome email, OET reminder WhatsApp, agreement letter, interview confirmation, non-selection email, placement confirmation, cohort welcome, follow-up SMS. Include realistic template body text with placeholders like {{nurse_name}}, {{cohort_name}}, {{date}}.
Update src/lib/data.ts to add getTemplates() and getTemplateById(id) async functions
Create src/store/template-store.ts with Zustand store: searchQuery, categoryFilter (All|Email|WhatsApp|Letter|SMS|Document), statusFilter (All|Active|Draft|Archived), selectedTemplateId
Create src/app/templates/page.tsx as a server component that calls getTemplates() and renders the TemplateLibrary client component

Create src/components/templates/TemplateLibrary.tsx ('use client') - main container with: header (title + 'Create Template' button placeholder), search bar, category filter chips, status filter, and template card grid

Create src/components/templates/TemplateCard.tsx - a card showing: template name, category badge (color-coded per category), subject line preview (for emails), body preview (first 2 lines truncated), tags as small chips, usage count, last modified date

Create src/components/templates/TemplateDetail.tsx - a detail view showing: full template metadata, the complete body content rendered in a styled preview area with placeholder highlighting ({{placeholders}} shown in propela-purple), copy button, and usage stats
Create src/app/templates/[id]/page.tsx as a server component rendering TemplateDetail
Update src/components/sidebar.tsx to add Templates nav item (using FileText icon from Lucide) as the last item before any settings
acceptance_criteria: pnpm build succeeds with no TypeScript errors
/templates route renders a grid of template cards with category badges, previews, and stats
/templates/[id] route renders the full template detail with body content and highlighted placeholders
Category filter chips (All, Email, WhatsApp, Letter, SMS, Document) filter the template cards
Search filters templates by name or body content
Styling matches existing patterns with propela-purple accents and consistent card design
verification: Run pnpm build and confirm zero errors
Run pnpm lint and confirm zero errors or only warnings
